what: Step-0 loss of published weights, converted with MaxText's own converter, through jax_titan.trainer.train (--model=maxtext:<name>, one stage, --init_from) against transformers' model in PyTorch on the same batch
batch: 8 sequences of 1,024 tokens of WikiText-103's validation split in the model's own tokens: the windows the trainer draws at step 0 with --seed=0
reference: transformers 5.23.0 with torch 2.10.0 on CPU, AutoModelForCausalLM in fp32 and with bf16 weights, mean cross-entropy over every position
jax_titan: fp32 parameters; compute in fp32 or bf16; dp on one MI350X, qwen3-30b-a3b fsdp on 8; peak_hbm_gib is the least and the most over the GPUs
